thread:
priya_se: Quick heads-up — Fjord Health hit a blocker during the SI handoff for their hybrid deployment. Azure Gov marketplace image fails attestation when the on-prem gateway (edge-nic) tries to register. Stuck on cert chain + kernel module mismatch.

sam_infra: Ugh. Do we have the installer logs + attestation output? can you paste the marketplace image digest and the failing cert fingerprint? :eyes:

priya_se: attaching snippets below. customer reports: `registry://redwood-marketplace/edge-gateway:2026-03-1` and attestation error `ERR_ATTEST_401: chain_untrusted`. They also saw `modprobe: FATAL: Module nvidia_uvm not found` on the local node.

jordan_solutions: I'll run an architecture review for this — appears to be two parallel issues: marketplace image signature/attest and on-prem driver mismatch. Suggest a 30m sync with Fjord + field eng + security. Available 11:30am PT.

maya_fieldeng: I'll be on-site tomorrow morning but can join remote now if needed. Who's taking ownership for the rollback plan? we might need to pin to older marketplace manifest for the go-live.

nate_security: Need the certificate chain (PEM) and the signer cert serial. Also confirm if customer uses internal PKI or Azure Key Vault. If the attestation failure is from missing root CA, we should be able to validate quickly.

priya_se: pasted attestation log: 
```
[attest] time=2026-03-12T14:12:08Z level=error msg="chain validation failed" err="x509: certificate signed by unknown authority"
[install] kernel: modprobe nvidia_uvm failed: no such module
```
Customer says their nodes are RHEL 8.6 with a custom DKMS stack.

sam_infra: ok — alloc tasks: @nate_security check cert chain and confirm whether we need to ship a CA bundle to the install flow. @maya_fieldeng verify node kernel and driver list with customer (uname -r + dkms status). @jordan_solutions schedule the arch review invite (include field-eng runbook). I'll validate marketplace manifest and confirm whether a previous image digest is available to roll back.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: #INC-48672 - "FjordHealth SI handoff: marketplace attestation + driver mismatch" assigned to partnerships@redwood. ETA: initial triage 2h.

jordan_solutions: Invite sent for 11:30am PT (30m). agenda: 1) collect logs + digests 2) quick cert chain triage 3) rollback/pinning plan 4) go/no-go for canary deploy.

maya_fieldeng: Customer contact info: Lina (ops) <lina@fjordhealth.com>, on-site exec is available. I'll gather `uname -r`, `lsmod | grep nvidia`, and `dkms status` and paste into the thread.

nate_security: quick triage: the attestation chain shows a customer intermediate signed by their internal CA — not in Redwood attestor whitelist. We can: A) accept with explicit allowlist for this deployment (requires security sign-off), B) ask customer to present CA to marketplace attestation service, or C) provide a temporary bypass for canary. Recommend A with audit trail if go-live is urgent.

priya_se: for rollback option, sam — can you confirm command to pin older digest? I have `az acr repository show-manifests` but want a one-liner to switch deployment route to digest.

sam_infra: you can patch the deployment to use digest, e.g.:
```
kubectl -n redwood patch deployment edge-gateway -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"edge-gateway","image":"registry://redwood-marketplace/edge-gateway@sha256:aaaabbbbccccdddd"}]}}}}'
```
That will force the canary to the older image. test in staging first.

jordan_solutions: If we do a temporary allowlist (nate's option A), we need signed approval from security and product for audit. nate, can you draft the approval language?

nate_security: Drafted: "Security approves a temporary allowlist entry for Fjord Health CA for canary deployment only. Conditions: 1) entry expires after 72h, 2) full CA chain is archived to customer file in ticket, 3) postmortem required if anything unexpected." Dropping into the ticket.

maya_fieldeng: pasted customer node output: `uname -r: 4.18.0-425.el8.x86_64`, `dkms status: nvidia, 470.182.03, installed`, `lsmod`: shows `nvidia` but no `nvidia_uvm`. Looks like customer didn't build UVM module.

priya_se: OK — plan for the next 24h: 1) short call 11:30am PT to align (jordan) 2) security triage and possible temporary allowlist (nate) 3) field eng to attempt UVM build or advise driver install (maya) 4) infra to prepare digest pin rollback if needed (sam). I'll own customer comms and ETA updates.

sam_infra: noted. I'll stage the rollback manifest and test the pin in staging cluster, will report back within 3h.

deploy-bot: Update on #INC-48672: triage started by sam_infra. Next update expected 2026-03-12T16:30:00Z.

jordan_solutions: Thanks all — please paste any logs in the ticket thread. we'll reconvene after the 11:30 sync. :thumbsup:
